**Goal `ext-compiler`. Stages 1 to 4 are done; Stage 5 (the source section) is next.** The design is ADR 0246 § 8 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*. This goal has no record slot.

Stage 4's three checks pass: all five cases of `an-extension-call-keeps-every-qualifier-rule`, including `tests/conformance/ext/a-manifest-declaring-a-secret-return-does-not-load.nvst`, which loads the fixture `Shop\Vault` and expects `E0652` naming the `secret` return.

A fixture whose directory has a `refused.txt` is one whose manifest must not load. `crates/nvs-ext/tests/fixtures.rs` packs it with a stand-in manifest and splices its own `manifest.json` in place; the module doc says how, and `a_fixture_with_a_refusal_does_not_load_and_gives_it` holds each refused fixture to its text. `NVS_WRITE_FIXTURES=1 cargo test --test fixtures` rewrites the bytes.

items.text: **A source file outside the extension's namespace refuses the load, naming the file**: `Source::parse` or the loader checks each packed path against the manifest class's namespace (`crates/nvs-ext/src/source.rs:47`). Check `nvs-ext` test `a_source_file_outside_the_extension_namespace_is_refused_naming_the_file`. `rule:packaging/extension-calls-are-statically-typed`.

**A loaded extension's namespace resolves through `autoload` with no line written** (`crates/nvs-hir/src/resolve.rs:340`). Check `nvs-hir` test `an_extension_namespace_resolves_through_autoload_with_no_line_written`, then the case `tests/conformance/ext/an-extension-source-class-resolves-with-no-autoload-line.nvst` against `ledger`'s `Ledger/Receipt.nvs`.
